title: Personnel Management
description: Maintain personnel profiles and enroll face templates for visual inference algorithms.

table.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or personnel ID...
table.loadFailed: Failed to load personnel data. Please check connection.
table.emptyDesc: Click '+ Add Person' to register your first profile

export.tooltip: Export a CSV using the current search and face-status filters. It lists names, personnel IDs and suggested photo filenames, ready to feed back into Bulk Import Faces.

dialogs.createDesc: Register a new person. If ID is omitted, the system will generate a unique key.
dialogs.editDesc: Update profile name. The personnel ID is immutable once created.
dialogs.deleteDesc: This action cannot be undone. Deleting '{{name}}' will cascade and remove all enrolled face templates!
dialogs.facesDesc: Manage 1:N face templates for feature extraction and recognition.
dialogs.batchDeleteDesc: This action will permanently delete {{count}} personnel records and all associated face data. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.confirmDeletePrompt: Type '{{word}}' to confirm this destructive action:

fields.dragDropTip: Click to select or drag photo here
fields.initialFaceTip: Drag or click to upload; automatically modeled as primary face upon creation
fields.batchUploadTip: Select multiple face photos to enroll in batch

status.emptyFacesDesc: Select or drag photos below to enroll faces.

notifications.createSuccessWithFace: Person '{{name}}' created and initial face enrolled successfully!
notifications.createSuccessFaceFailed: Person '{{name}}' created, but initial face enrollment failed: {{error}}.

imagePreview.title: Face photo preview

import.title: Bulk Import Personnel
import.description: Upload a UTF-8 CSV, review validation results, then confirm valid personnel. Columns: name and personId.
import.formatHint: First row is the header. Name is required; personnel ID is optional. Column order may vary.
import.retryHint: Check the file and try again

errors.IMPORT_DUPLICATE_PERSON_ID: Personnel ID is duplicated in the file
errors.IMPORT_COLUMN_COUNT: Column count does not match the header

faceImport.title: Bulk Import Person Faces
faceImport.description: Upload a ZIP archive with photos and optional manifest for AI quality-gated face feature extraction and gallery enrollment.
faceImport.chooseZip: Click to select or drag & drop ZIP archive
faceImport.fileHint: Standard ZIP format supported, up to 200MB
faceImport.spec1: Manifest-driven (recommended): Root contains manifest.csv and images/ directory.
faceImport.spec2: Adaptive mode: If manifest is omitted, files matching [personId]_[name].jpg are auto-enrolled.
faceImport.spec3: AI Quality Gate: Group photos (multiple faces), no face, and extreme side poses are rejected and logged in the failure report.
faceImport.selectZipError: Please select a ZIP archive file
faceImport.jobStarted: Import job created, background extraction started
faceImport.statusProcessing: AI face vetting & feature extraction in progress...
faceImport.completeSummary: Successfully enrolled {{succeeded}} face templates; {{failed}} items failed quality gates.

faceReextract.toolbarTooltip: Re-compute 512-d face embeddings for the full gallery from stored original photos using the active algorithm package
faceReextract.title: Re-extract Face Features
faceReextract.description: Re-compute 512-dimensional embeddings for enrolled photos using the active face algorithm and sync updates to running tasks.
faceReextract.scopeAll: All enrolled face photos in the gallery
faceReextract.scopeSelected: All face photos of {{count}} selected personnel
faceReextract.notePreserve: Updates embeddings in place, preserving face IDs, primary face assignments, and historical record links.
faceReextract.noteFallback: If an image is missing or fails extraction under the new model, its existing embedding is preserved and logged in the failure report.
faceReextract.noteResource: Runs asynchronously in the background; NPU/CPU utilization on edge devices may increase temporarily.
faceReextract.jobStarted: Re-extraction job created, background processing started
faceReextract.runningInBackground: Re-extraction job continues running in background
